entities.summary: Mario Scaramella is a lawyer and security consultant. He came to international prominence in 2006 in connection with the poisoning of the ex-Federal Security Service (FSB) agent Alexander Litvinenko. He served as an investigator and adviser to the Mitrokhin Commission, with responsibility for intelligence analysis and production on KGB and military GRU espionage in Europe. Scaramella was a suspect by the Italian justice department for calumny.
